data.signboardText: शर्मा जनरल स्टोर SHARMA GENERAL STORE
observations: The shop's signboard clearly displays 'Sharma General Store' in both Hindi and English, matching the declared shop name.
The shop appears to be fully operational with an open shutter and well-stocked shelves.
A UPI 'Scan & Pay' QR code is prominently displayed, indicating acceptance of digital payments.
A blackboard outside lists daily prices for milk, bread, and eggs.
Several large sacks of what appear to be grains or flour are displayed outside the shop, suggesting bulk item sales.
